slrrGarageEnter.title: Wrench Works: enter nearest garage
slrrGarageEnter.desc: Sends the car into the nearest garage on this map without driving up to the door.

slrrRadioToggle.title: Wrench Works: radio on/off
slrrRadioToggle.desc: Switches the car radio on or off.

slrrRadioNext.title: Wrench Works: next radio station
slrrRadioNext.desc: Tunes the car radio to the next station (one per music folder).

slrrGarageSkip.title: Wrench Works: skip the arrival scene
slrrGarageSkip.desc: Cuts the driver getting out of the car in the garage short.

slrrGarageLeave.title: Wrench Works: drive out
slrrGarageLeave.desc: Fits everything and drives out of the garage.
